blocks.text: DANDONG — North Korean leader Kim Jong Un returned home Saturday after a day-long trip to the Chinese border city of Dandong, vowing to “firmly carry forward” the two nations’ friendship, Pyongyang’s state media reported. Kim’s visit follows the official opening of a major cross-border bridge last week — 12 years after its completion — deepening economic ties between China and diplomatically isolated North Korea. Neither North Korea nor China disclosed Kim’s visit in advance.
